object_description: compact cross-stacked blocks around courtyards and cavities
design_condition: Three cross-stacked blocks are placed centrally within the perimeter, creating a tree-lined western square and diverse elevated outdoor spaces while preserving eastern room for future expansion.

positive.statement: The sophisticated staggering fits very well into the urban planning situation.

position.rationale: Cross-stacked blocks and cantilevered offsets are visibly staggered across the mass.

positive.statement: The project offers a spacious and attractively designed entrance area, courtyards and terraces.

position.rationale: Western square and elevated cavities visibly organize entrances, courtyards, and terraces.

positive.statement: The different levels and open and covered conditions create a diverse range of stay options.

position.target: different levels and open and covered conditions
position.rationale: Overlapping blocks visibly create varied open, covered, and elevated conditions.

positive.statement: The incidence of natural light in large parts of the teaching areas offers a very special quality.

position.rationale: Large interior zones are approximated beneath the daylight-accessible stacked blocks.

positive.statement: The networking of the building parts creates a variety of visual relationships.

position.rationale: Central cavities and interlocking volumes visibly connect multiple building parts.

positive.statement: The facade expression authentically reflects the building's use and gives the ensemble an appropriate scale.

position.rationale: Stacked outer faces visibly express the building's multi-level scale and use.

positive.statement: The large building volume is convincingly integrated into its surroundings, with harmonious proportions.

position.rationale: Compact cross-stacked envelope is anchored at its outer eastern mass.

negative.statement: The three-dimensional building grid dictates the internal organization in a strong and almost cartoonish way.

position.rationale: Repeated stacked axes and projections visibly dominate the overall organization.

negative.statement: The multiplication of vertical axes makes orientation through the building complex very difficult.

position.rationale: Multiple aligned vertical stacks converge around the central complex.

negative.statement: Flexibility of use is limited by the resulting arrangement of usable areas.

position.rationale: Resulting interior arrangement is approximated beneath the eastern stacked blocks.

negative.statement: The structural concept becomes relatively complex because of the many projections, recesses and volumetric gimmicks.

position.rationale: Cantilevered corners and recessed joints are clearly visible on the upper mass.

negative.statement: The delivery of materials to the special-use areas and workshops is not optimal.

position.target: material delivery to special-use areas and workshops
position.rationale: Eastern lower edge is a constrained approximation for service access and workshops.

negative.statement: Construction and maintenance costs are expected to be above average.

position.rationale: Cost judgment has no single useful spatial referent.
